uncited: The Blue Noise Jitter Generator produces temporally coherent, spatially blue-noise-distributed offsets for ray origins or sampling positions.

It combines a low-discrepancy spatial lookup table with a golden-ratio-based temporal shift and a Halton sequence for subpixel jitter, ensuring that jitter values change smoothly across frames while maintaining blue-noise spectral properties.

It differs from [Hammersley Sampling](8569-hammersley-sampling.md) by explicitly decoupling spatial structure (via a precomputed table) from temporal evolution (via modular golden-ratio shifts), which reduces temporal aliasing artifacts in animated scenes.
